question: Why do the sky-elephant beings bow to the goddess under her title as chief of the divine world?
premises: They address her by a specific name.
That name identifies her as chief of the divine world.
inference: Her sovereignty over the divine realm elicits homage from celestial beings.
uncertainties: The exact identity of antarikṣa+gaja+nāḥ is context-dependent.
plain_english: The beings of the sky-elephants bow to her by the name 'chief of the divine world'.
